A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] worked as a '''dancer''' and [[entertainer]] at the [[Dealer's Den]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Revan" /> in [[3954 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> She was giving a private performance to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Canderous Ordo]] when the Mandalorian's friend, legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], arrived to meet him and discuss what had caused the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. After seeing Revan, Ordo dismissed the dancer who stomped off with her [[Lekku/Legends|head-tails]] twitching in irritation shooting Revan an angry glare.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek dancer appeared within [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="Revan" />
